description: This file implements the core operational functions of the TLS Record Client Object, specifically engaging and canceling the object's activity status.

classes.name: TLS_RECORD_CLIENT_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the TLS Record Client Object with an activity status flag.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsRcoEngage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Activates the TLS Record Client Object by setting its active flag to TRUE if not already active.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsRcoCancel(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Deactivates the TLS Record Client Object by setting its active flag to FALSE if it is currently active.
